spec.summary: Add the repo-audit runner and issue-draft output
spec.expected_outcome: Confirm the migrated scope and acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: `audit.sh --repo <path> --dry-run` writes a report and drafts; no
Dedupe against open issues by title and evidence.
Each draft records model, version, prompt hash, and evidence paths.
No issue creation and no PR in this issue.
Fixtures use recorded model outputs; CI makes no live model calls.
Docs cover cadence, cost, privacy, and review.
